context_requirements: Expression of AGTR2 or other angiotensin receptors; most of these lines are not known to express functional AGTR2 at levels sufficient for transcriptional signaling.
An intact angiotensin II signaling axis; no exogenous angiotensin II is added in this experiment.
The drug must engage a receptor that is coupled to transcriptional programs; AGTR2 is largely antiproliferative and may not produce measurable mRNA changes in 6-24 h.
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls.
Changes in known angiotensin receptor target genes or downstream MAPK/STAT programs.
